verdict.rationale: Foreloop's feedback widget lets a user mark up a screenshot and submit it, and that submission is turned into an intention/task that an agent later reads and implements (foreloop-docs-21, foreloop-docs-23, foreloop-docs-12), which supports the core of the story. However this is framed as an end-user/customer feedback flow rather than a developer directly attaching a screenshot/mockup to a task from their own workflow, and there's no evidence of mockup file uploads (vs. live-page screenshots) or of a CLI/task-creation path for developers to attach such artifacts. missing for 10: developer-facing (not just customer-widget) flow for attaching a mockup to a task, support for arbitrary mockup files (not just screenshot-of-current-page), and confirmation the agent parses markup annotations to derive the specific visual change intended.
